card.name: Linking words before infection or complications
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, as, including, or, a comma, an opening parenthesis) right before the model expects 'infection' or 'complications'. Seen in lists of surgical or procedure risks.

modes.label: Risk-of phrases
modes.description: The word 'of' after risk, incidence or case, where infection or complications comes next.

modes.description: A comma, 'or' or 'such as' inside a list of side effects, with infection as the next item.
modes.example: of wound-related complications like wound dehiscence<<,>> wound infection, incisional hernia
